title: Fixed-wing golden demo: ArduPlane 4.6.3 SITL on a 27.6 km route, coherent GPS drag, golden-demo monitor, EKF3 switch to ExternalNav fed by measured day (VPAIR) and night (thermal) geoloc fix models vs airspeed dead reckoning only
summary: ArduPlane Plane-4.6.3 SITL in Docker (new image built on the sitl-docker copter image) flies a 27.6 km route at 300 m and 22 m/s airspeed in 6 m/s wind. A pymavlink companion injects the only GPS as GPS_INPUT and drags it east at 1 m/s, position and velocity together, from t = 480 s. It runs the samples/golden-demo solution-separation bank and GNSS-vs-reference velocity test (imported unchanged) against a velocity reference calibrated while GNSS is trusted (VO by day, airspeed + own compass + wind at night and for dead reckoning) and on the first alarm commands MAV_CMD_SET_EKF_SOURCE_SET: set 2 = ExternalNav fed with the companion's GNSS-free reference, built from geoloc fixes drawn from measured models (VPAIR 79 % availability, 2.6 m median; Thermal-UAV 15 %, measured error pool), or set 3 = no position or velocity source, EKF3 airspeed + sideslip + compass + wind dead reckoning. Reports detection time, cross-track error vs distance with and without the monitor, day vs night, dead reckoning, and where each aircraft loiters at the end; navdash/1 output for templates/demo-dashboard.
verified: Ran 2026-11-06 on Apple Silicon (linux/arm64 Docker, plane-sitl-ardupilot:4.6.3 built from Dockerfile.plane in 40 s on top of nav-sitl-ardupilot:copter-4.6.3, pymavlink 2.4.50, Python 3.12, speedup 5, 4-8 SITLs in parallel, ~290 s wall per batch). 16 coherent-spoof flights (seed 7 + seeds 1-3 x baseline/day/night/dr), 4 no-spoof flights, 1 dr flight with VO detection; all completed the route and end loiter, no failsafe, no GPS-unhealthy message, every source-set command ACKed. Seed 7: first alarm 5.4 s (day, velocity test), 27.4 s (night, SS), 228.4 s (dr, SS); max true cross-track after onset 34.7 m day (3.3 m on straights; corners overshoot 30-32 m with no spoof), 37.9 m night, 696.7 m dr, 749.7 m without monitor; end-loiter centre 14.8 / 20.6 / 806.7 / 873.2 m from the commanded point (no-spoof 15.0 m). Seeds 1-3: day alarm 7.4-9.4 s, max 28-31 m; night 19.4-31.4 s, 33-50 m; dr 232-337 s, 687-745 m; baseline 749-751 m. EKF3 GPS_GLITCHING 0 reports in all 16. Dead reckoning: after a 4.4 s detection EKF3 source set 3 ended 844 m off route after 20.8 km (frozen wind about 1.1 m/s off); the dr monitor false-alarmed in its no-spoof flight at 358 s. Found and fixed: ExternalNav NED must use ArduPilot's spherical LATLON_TO_M, a WGS84 local ENU put the EKF 34-37 m off at 11 km. Tests: venv 14 pass; plain python3 12 pass, 2 skip (pymavlink; git-ignored thermal JSONL). Not tested: real VO/compass/camera, other drag rates or wind, AHRS_OPTIONS=0, amd64, Plane 4.7+.
group: Integrity and GNSS-loss response on a vehicle
shows: golden-demo monitor on an ArduPlane SITL 27.6 km route: coherent GPS drag, EKF3 switch to ExternalNav fed by measured day (VPAIR) / night (thermal) geoloc models vs airspeed dead reckoning only; cross-track vs distance and end-of-route behaviour
runtime: ./run.sh ~5 min wall (4 flights in parallel at speedup 5); plane image 40 s on top of the sitl-docker copter image
key_result: [Seed 7 + 3 seeds, coherent 1 m/s](README.md#results-ran-2026-11-06-seed-7-reference--seeds-1-3): day alarm 5-9 s, max cross-track 28-35 m (corners) and loiter 14.8 m from the point; night (15 % thermal fixes) 19-31 s, 33-50 m; airspeed dead reckoning only 687-745 m vs 749-751 m without monitor, and 844 m even after a 4.4 s detection; EKF3 never flagged GPS_GLITCHING
